items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: It was J. J., Joe Newman, Sir Charles, Al Lucas, Shadow Wilson... I had done quite a bit of research... I had done so many recordings with Jacquet Jacquet and Dizzy also... in that band was Leo Parker and Sir Charles Thompson, Joe Newman and Russell Jacquet, and J. J. Johnson, Al Lucas on bass

ctx.x: But that was a great little band. It was J. J., Joe Newman, Sir Charles, Al Lucas, Shadow Wilson, and the baritone player Leo --
